component.name: Eder
component.summary: Browse and read your local PDF library

description.p: Eder keeps your PDF library on your computer. Choose a folder, browse its documents and subfolders, and open a PDF to start reading. Your library and reading progress stay local, without an account or document uploads.

ul.li: Find documents with cover previews and filename search.
Keep favorites and recently opened documents close at hand.
Read one page at a time or scroll continuously.
Adjust zoom, fit pages to the window, and invert page colors.
Resume reading with saved positions for each document.

description.p: Text selection, annotations, printing, and password entry are not supported.

screenshot.caption: Browse favorite PDFs with cover previews
